items.title: Dick’s Sporting Goods CEO Calls GameChanger App a Secret Weapon
items.why: Scaled youth sports app points to family-focused sports spend as a growing engagement channel.
items.summary_ai: Dick's CEO says GameChanger, its youth sports app, is becoming a key growth driver, with revenue expected to approach $200 million this fiscal year.
items.take: Scaled youth sports app points to family-focused sports spend as a growing engagement channel.
